# Fallout 76: The Hinterlands - Update notes

March 3, 2026

Do you hear that? The wasteland of Appalachia calls you! The new update “The Hinterland” is here and brings a lot of new things to the region.

**Room, rumm, rumm**Bigfoot is coming! Climb into your Power Armor and grab your favorite weapons, because we have a legendary 4-star creature to hunt! The Hinterlands Update arrives today, bringing new rewards for all Vault Dwellers in the Wasteland, as well as convenience improvements for Public Events and Activities (formerly known as Events), your Pip-Boy, and your armor! Read on to learn everything you need to know about today's changes.
## Update highlights

**Bigfoot is here** - The legendary Bigfoot has appeared and will interfere in your public events. This 4-star legendary creature can drop a new, exclusive 4-star mod: The Adventurous.
**Uninvited Guests** - Bigfoot isn't the only one planning to spoil your fun. Other special creatures such as an even more powerful Deathclaw Matriarch, a Wendigo Colossus, and more may join you uninvited.
**Activities and Public Events Balancing** - Many activities (formerly "Events") and public events have been updated to improve their rewards and flow. So you spend less time waiting and more time playing.
**Pip-Boy Improvements** - Pip-Boy now runs faster and smoother and has some new menus to help you find what you're looking for faster.
**Armor Balancing** - Armor weight has been reduced (in and out of camps) and more resistances have been built directly into armor to give you more choice in how you protect yourself.
**Mood Lights** - With this new feature in Photo Mode, you can take photos at night or in dark interiors without having to worry about putting your character in the best light!
**Season 24: Rip Daring and the Cryptids from Outer Space** - Rip Daring sets off on a new adventure, this time full of extraterrestrial creatures! We hope you're ready for another daring adventure.

## Bigfoot is here

Bigfoot has emerged from hiding in the wastelands of Appalachia! From now on, at certain public events there is a chance that Bigfoot will appear at the end of the event, equipped with a huge branch to beat and blood-sucking ticks to throw. At which events? You'll have to find out for yourself, because if you kill this creature you'll have a chance at a legendary 4-star item with the new 4-star mod "The Adventurous One." To celebrate Bigfoot's arrival, we will be holding a small event for this larger-than-life creature: "Bigfoot's Party"! During the first full week of the update, there is an extremely high chance that Bigfoot and the public events in which he appears will appear. After that he becomes as camera shy as usual. We hope you're ready to take on this legendary cryptid! But note: If you take too long to kill him, he will disappear back into the wild. So strike quickly when you see him.
## Uninvited guests

Bigfoot isn't the only surprise that might await you at the end of a public event. The Wendigo Colossus or a Deathclaw Matriarch can spawn at the end of events like Guided Meditation or Distinguished Guests. But those aren't the only two creatures that can show up uninvited
